mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{actorId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE )

request.consent_request_id, request.request_code, request.organization_unit_id, request.recipient_id, request.processing_activity_id, request.processing_activity_version_id, request.consent_template_id, request.consent_template_version_id, request.retention_policy_version_id, request.request_status, request.expires_at, request.idempotency_key, request.current_secure_link_id, request.snapshot_id, request.created_by, request.created_at, request.version_no
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seal.consent_request request JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = request.organization_unit_id WHERE request.organization_unit_id = #{organizationId} AND request.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.consent_request (consent_request_id, request_code, organization_unit_id, recipient_id, processing_activity_id, processing_activity_version_id, consent_template_id, consent_template_version_id, retention_policy_version_id, request_status, expires_at, idempotency_key, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version_no) VALUES (#{row.requestId}, #{row.requestCode}, #{row.organizationUnitId}, #{row.recipientId}, #{row.processingActivityId}, #{row.processingActivityVersionId}, #{row.templateId}, #{row.templateVersionId}, #{row.retentionPolicyVersionId}, #{row.status}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{actorId}, #{now}, #{actorId}, #{now}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seal.consent_request request JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = request.organization_unit_id WHERE request.consent_request_id = #{requestId} AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_processing_activity_scope configured WHERE configured.admin_user_id = #{actorId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seal.user_processing_activity_scope allowed WHERE allowed.admin_user_id = #{actorId} AND allowed.processing_activity_id = request.processing_activity_id)) FOR UPDATE OF request
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.consent_request_snapshot (consent_request_snapshot_id, consent_request_id, snapshot_schema_version, snapshot_json, snapshot_hash, template_content_hash, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{snapshotId}, #{requestId}, 1, CAST(#{snapshot.canonicalJson} AS jsonb), #{snapshot.snapshotHash}, #{snapshot.templateContentHash}, #{actorId}, #{now})

INSERT INTO seal.consent_request_item (consent_request_item_id, consent_request_snapshot_id, item_order, item_code, item_type, item_title, required, purpose_text, retention_text, refusal_notice, third_party_recipient) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{snapshotId}, #{item.order}, #{item.code}, #{item.type}, #{item.title}, #{item.required}, #{item.purpose}, #{item.retentionText}, #{item.refusalNotice}, #{item.thirdPartyRecipient, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO seal.consent_request_item_data (consent_request_item_id, consent_request_snapshot_id, processing_data_item_id, item_order, item_name) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{snapshotId}, #{data.id}, #{data.order}, #{data.name})
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.consent_request SET request_status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_by = #{actorId}, cancelled_at = #{now}, cancellation_reason = #{reason}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = #{now}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE consent_request_id = #{requestId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} AND request_status IN ('DRAFT', 'READY', 'ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.consent_request_event (consent_request_event_id, consent_request_id, event_type, actor_type, actor_id, reason_code, created_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{requestId}, #{eventType}, #{actorType}, #{actorId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{reasonCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seal.consent_request request JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = request.organization_unit_id request.request_status = #{status} ORDER BY request.created_at DESC, request.consent_request_id LIMIT 100
